_instructions: One entry per candidate moment. Fill source fields ONLY from a video you actually watched. Leave url/timestamps empty until verified - the scorer blocks unverified entries. Scores: attention 0-20, comedy 0-25, relatability 0-15, surprise 0-15, meme 0-15, shortform 0-10.

candidates.context: What the audience knows before the punchline.
candidates.punchline: Exact words, transcribed from the video.
candidates.why_funny: Mechanism: misdirection, escalation, act-out, rule of three, callback, status reversal...
candidates.meme_idea: Editorial caption / sticker / SFX that comments without replacing the joke.
